text: It's gone 1am and I'm shattered, so forgive the rambling. I've got my granddaughter Maisie staying, she's 10, and she's been running a temperature since yesterday. 38.3 when I checked about half an hour ago. I've been giving her paracetamol and ibuprofen like the box says, and in between doses she's honestly her usual self, playing with her tablet, drinking her squash, chatting away nineteen to the dozen. She's wide awake now watching telly with me and earlier when she dozed off she woke up straight away when I called her. I just don't know how long I keep doing this before somebody needs to see her. Her mum's away till Thursday and I'm running on empty.
